description: This file is a Node.js script (watch-node.mjs) that sets up a file watching mechanism using chokidar to monitor specific paths, and spawns a child process to run a specified node script, restarting it on file changes. It manages signals and shutdown procedures for a development or build workflow.

methods.name: runWatchMain
methods.description: Main function to initiate the file watch process, spawn child process, handle events and signals.
